_note: Ported from the browser version's rule constants. Board: 8 x 8 hexes; the 12 corner hexes are void. Costs and amounts are in gold unless noted. Since 2026-11-10 forts, barracks, barracks upgrades, walls, trebuchets and Watering Holes are paid in materials (bought at markets).

board.one_time_gold_hexes: a third of the open hexes hold a one-time 10 gold for whoever takes them first

buildings._note: Markets cost gold; forts, barracks and Watering Holes cost materials, as do barracks upgrades.

crate._note: Material hexes (Ethan, 2026-11-17): the first side to take one gets this many materials (not the Mythical).

trebuchet.shot_note: a trebuchet: 8 materials on a hex with a fort; each shot rolls 5 dice and every 4 or higher kills one unit

robots._note: Ethan, 2026-11-11: one Robot building per hex. It starts as a market; then either more markets on that hex (a resource hex, up to markets_max) or, from the home castle during Advancements, a barracks and then a fortress (a factory). Never both. factory_units: Factory Run's Brawlers. trades: Mobilize's Recompile, Rebuild and Refit.

dinos._note: The Dinosaurs build no forts or trebuchets (Ethan, 2026-11-09). Alamosaurus guards are hired for a barracks; the home castle's volcano replaces trebuchets. Since 2026-11-11 every Dinosaur card has its own upgrades (upgrades.json dinos_cards); Herd, Migrate, Nesting, Populate, Abundance and Rainy Season are retired.

armor._note: The Hunt, Advancements level 3: bought at the home castle; +2 damage and +10% health in every battle (Arena battles too).

faction_start_mods.note: The base values for every faction are in factions.json under base_mods.

mythical._note: The Mythical earn and spend only magic. Prices are placeholders until Ethan sets them (browser MYTH, 2026-11-07).
mage_lv_note: Dragons, units 1 magic cheaper, longer lightning, +1 damage, 3 Mages a hex
mythical._mage_req_note: Ethan, 2026-11-11: each Mage level also needs Life Trees and captured castles (castles you hold other than your home) when you raise it; a castle lost later doesn't take the level away.

materials._note: Ethan, 2026-11-10: each market (and the home castle, while you hold it) sells up to 3 materials a turn at 2 gold each, any time on your turn. Units, markets, Alamosaurus guards and the volcano stay gold. The Mythical keep magic for everything.

fortify._note: Fortify is a wild card (Ethan, 2026-11-10/11): a regroup (moves of up to 2 hexes through your own land, as many as you like; the units stay ready), then Build, Advancements or Recruit at the basic level: 2 picks at level 2, all 3 at level 3. The old +1 defense is gone.

board3._note: Three-player board (Ethan, 2026-11-09): an 11 x 11 grid cut to a hexagon of radius 5, less its 6 corners and the 2 edge hexes beside each corner between the homes: 79 hexes. Twice the 2-player board's mountains, water and coins. Terrain comes in 120-degree sets so every home has the same around it.

three_players._note: Catch-up for later seats: 3/4 of the 2-player second-seat gold (or magic) per seat behind (6 and 12 gold). The last side standing wins; no castle-count win and no siege.
